note: A move is a position in a shape, filled by a family (object model §1). The twenty moves are the twenty corpus families of the 2026-08-29 inventory: F1-F19 and F21. There is no F20.

moves.name: Just do it
moves.test: The responder supplies exactly what the prior turn asked for, adds nothing beyond it, and does not qualify it.
moves.presupposes: Prerequisite to everything. Composes into every other shape.

moves.name: Do it and throw something in
moves.test: The responder grants, then volunteers material the ticket did not ask for.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1, and that the asker can survive unrequested information — i.e. F7 repair survivable.

moves.name: Answer with a question
moves.test: The response position is filled by a question rather than by an answer or a compliance.
moves.position: TICKET → COUNTER-Q → SPECIFY → grant. Positions 2 and 3 as a bound pair.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F7/F8 repair survivable. The corpus’s clearest survivability edge.

moves.name: Roughly, and it depends
moves.test: The answer is given with an explicit hedge, an approximation or a condition attached.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1, and that the asker can act on an uncommitted answer. Zero uptake anywhere — see U4.

moves.name: No, and here’s why, and here’s instead
moves.test: The responder declines a proposal, gives an account, and offers a counter-proposal — all three parts.
moves.position: PROPOSAL → DECLINE+ACCOUNT+COUNTER → decline+account+counter → accept. Positions 2 and 3.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1 and F14, and surviving the other’s counter-decline. Both attestations in scene 4.

moves.name: Not that, but this
moves.test: The ticket is declined in substance and something is substituted in the same turn, with no apology or account.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1 and F4, and that the asker can re-select.

moves.name: Say that again
moves.test: The responder declares non-understanding and requests a repeat.
moves.presupposes: No prerequisites. Prerequisite to almost everything else.

moves.name: Said again, differently
moves.test: The responder grants a repair request and reformulates rather than merely repeating.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1. Prerequisite for F3 and F9.

moves.name: Let me check I’ve got it
moves.test: The responder offers back a candidate version of what they just heard, and the other party confirms.
moves.position: INSTRUCTION → READ-BACK → CONFIRM-AND-EXTEND. Positions 2 and 3, bound.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F8 — a read-back that is wrong gets corrected.

moves.name: Keep going
moves.test: A minimal turn whose only content is a request to continue.
moves.position: LONG TURN → CONTINUER → continuation. Position 2, inside a chain.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F7 survivable — you must survive the continuation you just invited.

moves.name: And you?
moves.test: The responder answers and hands the identical question straight back, in the same turn, minimally.
moves.position: Q → A + RETURN → A + return → … Position 2, and it is what makes the shape recursive.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1. Composes the acquaintance shape into itself.

moves.name: Nice one
moves.test: The responder assesses the other party, their choice, their offering or their help.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1 and F14. Prerequisite for F13, F17, F18.

moves.name: Kind of you, but
moves.test: The responder receives a compliment, thanks for it, and immediately downgrades the claim about themselves.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F12 and F14. Prerequisite for F17.

moves.name: The done thing
moves.test: The turn’s whole job is to return a ritual with its matching ritual. No propositional content is exchanged.
moves.position: HAIL → RETURN. Position 2. Also the closing position of most transaction shapes.
moves.presupposes: No prerequisites. Composes into the open and the close of every other shape.

moves.name: I’m not sure
moves.test: The responder declines to commit either way and buys time, usually with a counter-request.
moves.position: OFFER → NON-COMMITMENT + DEFER → resource → decide. Position 2.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1 and F3. The only turn in the corpus that refuses to decide.

moves.name: Fair enough, but I still
moves.test: The responder concedes the other’s point and then holds their own position with a “but”.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F12, and disagreement survivable. All three attestations in scene 22.

moves.name: No you’re not
moves.test: The responder contradicts the other party’s account of themselves, positively.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F12 and F13. The corpus’s only disagreement of any kind. Both attestations in scene 22.

moves.name: That’s normal, isn’t it?
moves.test: The responder normalises the other’s difficulty and invites agreement with a tag; the partner agrees emphatically.
moves.position: DIFFICULTY → NORMALISE+TAG → EMPHATIC AGREE. Positions 2 and 3, bound.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F12 and F16. Both attestations in scene 22, the last two rows of the corpus.

moves.name: Here’s how I am
moves.test: The responder answers a formulaic wellbeing enquiry with a state report.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F14. May be a sub-case of F14 — see U10.

moves.name: Anything else?
moves.test: The responder completes the ticket and immediately solicits a further one in the same turn.
moves.position: GRANT → ONWARD SOLICIT → new ticket. Position 2→1 pivot.
moves.presupposes: Presupposes F1. Composes the transaction shape into a chain.
